attributes.name: footer divider above copyright
attributes.definition: Whether a horizontal divider line separates the copyright/legal row from the rest of the footer.

values.definition: A thin horizontal rule sits above the copyright or legal row.
No rule separates the copyright row.
Separation is by other means, such as a heavy border or a background change.

attributes.name: copyright text styling
attributes.definition: Size, weight and case treatment of the copyright or legal text line.

values.definition: The copyright or legal text is small and light in weight or colour.
The copyright text is small, mixed-case and underlined.
The copyright text is the same size as body text.

attributes.name: copyright row layout
attributes.definition: How the copyright row is positioned within the footer.

values.definition: The copyright spans the full width as its own row at the bottom of the footer.
The copyright sits inside a footer column or alongside other content.
The copyright sits below a divider and its width is not described.

attributes.name: footer column density
attributes.definition: Number of link columns in the footer.

values.definition: The footer has a reduced number of columns.
The footer has a large number of columns.
